stories.h: Boeing to cut about 5% of commercial airplane workforce
stories.s: Boeing Commercial Airplanes plans to shed roughly 2,500 jobs through layoffs and attrition, with notices starting in December, after slowing its production ramp. Affected sites haven't been named, but Everett is a major assembly hub.

stories.h: Snohomish County Council passes $3.37B budget on 3-2 vote
stories.s: The 2027-28 budget passed with Republicans Sam Low and Nate Nehring opposed, citing higher property taxes and fees. Supporters noted the executive cut $22 million and 90 positions.

stories.h: About 2,700 plants seized in unlicensed Monroe cannabis grow
stories.s: State cannabis investigators and the regional drug task force raided a property in unincorporated Monroe on Nov. 6. A 70-year-old man was arrested on felony charges and later released on bond.

stories.h: Rain, rising winds return Friday after mild Thursday
stories.s: Thursday stays mostly dry and mild in the low 60s, with winds picking up in the evening. Rain arrives Friday, and stronger winds are expected Saturday night into Sunday.

coming.h: Skate America comes to Everett's Angel of the Winds Arena
coming.s: The Grand Prix figure skating event opens Friday at 7 p.m. with men's and pairs short programs and runs through Sunday. Alysa Liu and Ilia Malinin are among the U.S. skaters.

coming.h: WSU plays Hawaii in Everett's first Division I men's game
coming.s: Washington State faces Hawaii at 7 p.m. at Angel of the Winds Arena, the venue's first Division I men's basketball game.
